standards.scope: Manual whole diff review; tooling-enforced style is not repeated.

spec.scope: Diagnostic metadata only; not a product repair or production acceptance.

reviewed_boundaries.first_body: BYTE_EXACT after only new fixture argument/two new observation lines are removed
reviewed_boundaries.grade_helper: BYTE_EXACT after only new observation declaration/marks/poll recorder are removed
reviewed_boundaries.config: Original Git bytes unchanged; actual metadata timeout30000/retry0; original once1worker
reviewed_boundaries.write_failure: outputPath/stringification/write caught, fixed safe annotation, saved flag before one wx attempt; no assertion swallowed. Abrupt termination and fault paths not runtime-qualified

actual_owner_result.auxiliary_same_package_declaration_alias: PASS exit0, conditional separate environment; alias removed; not original-install strict acceptance

audit_auxiliary_exceptions.actual_error: MODULE_NOT_FOUND for the explicitly named owner TypeScript dependency path
audit_auxiliary_exceptions.meaning: No AST result, installation, borrowed dependency environment or product failure inference

audit_auxiliary_exceptions.actual_error: File absent; actual correct tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts subsequently read
audit_auxiliary_exceptions.meaning: Read-path error, not a test result

not_run: fault injection of setup failure or diagnostic write failure
skill_process: code-review axes kept separate. All4 available agent slots occupied; no parallel reviewer agents claimed and no other owner interrupted. Explicit sole spec takes precedence over generic issue-tracker setup.
